timeline.summary: On May 4, 2026, Asahi India Glass reported a partial breakdown of an exhaust chimney at its Soniyana plant due to a local squall, with no impact on operations or supplies.
Asahi India Glass disclosed Maruti Suzuki's 10.59% shareholding and nil encumbrance under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.
Shareholders approved Mr. Takahiro Tokuda (DIN: 09544810) as Non-Executive Independent Director via postal ballot on 9 May 2026 with 95.5% votes in favor.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,354.06 Cr (+14.8% YoY), net profit ₹132.61 Cr (+44.9% YoY).

watchlist.text: Approval of shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting for the dividend
